_meta.indication: VOTRIENT is indicated for the treatment of patients with advanced renal cell carcinoma (RCC).

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicenter study; patients randomized 2:1 to VOTRIENT 800 mg once daily or placebo once daily.
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with locally advanced and/or metastatic RCC who had received either no prior therapy or one prior cytokine-based systemic therapy; all had clear cell or predominantly clear cell histology.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Progression-free survival (PFS) by independent radiological review was the primary endpoint; secondary endpoints included overall survival, overall response rate, and duration of response.
pivotal_trials.result: Median PFS 9.2 months with VOTRIENT vs 4.2 months with placebo; HR 0.46 (95% CI 0.34, 0.62), P value <0.001. Response rate 30% vs 3%.

nct_ctgov.title: Safety and Efficacy of GW786034 (Pazopanib) In Metastatic Renal Cell Carcinoma

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥20%) were diarrhea (52%), hypertension (40%), hair color changes (38%), nausea (26%), anorexia (22%), and vomiting (21%). Serious risks include severe/fatal hepatotoxicity, QT prolongation/torsades, hemorrhage, and hypertension.
target_moa: Pazopanib is a multi-tyrosine kinase inhibitor of VEGFR-1, -2, -3, PDGFR-α and -β, FGFR-1 and -3, Kit, Itk, Lck and others; its anti-angiogenic activity underlies effectiveness in RCC.

boxed_warning.content: WARNING: HEPATOTOXICITY — Severe and fatal hepatotoxicity has been observed in clinical studies. Monitor hepatic function and interrupt, reduce, or discontinue dosing as recommended.

rems.type: A REMS was approved, consisting of a Medication Guide and a timetable for submission of REMS assessments.

advisory_committee.vote: The Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee met October 5, 2009 and voted 10 to 0 that the benefit-to-risk profile was acceptable for treatment of patients with advanced RCC.

description.text: Updated labeling to reflect final overall survival data from the pivotal Phase 3 renal cell carcinoma trial

citations.quote: This “Prior Approval” supplemental new drug application proposes draft labeling reflecting updated information regarding the final overall survival data from the pivotal Phase 3 trial for Renal Cell Carcinoma.

description.text: Added indication for treatment of advanced soft tissue sarcoma in patients who received prior chemotherapy

citations.quote: “Votrient is indicated for the treatment of patients with advanced soft tissue sarcoma (STS) who have received prior chemotherapy. Limitation of Use: The efficacy of Votrient for the treatment of patients with adipocytic STS or gastrointestinal stromal tumors has not been demonstrated.”

description.text: Added cardiotoxicity clinical data to Warnings and Precautions in response to Postmarketing Requirement 1549-2 (no new indication/population)

citations.quote: This “Prior Approval” supplemental new drug application proposes changes to the Warnings and Precautions section of the Prescribing Information (i.e. inclusion of clinical data) in response to Post Marketing Requirement 1549-2, to examine the cardiotoxicity, clinical cardiac events, and changes in ejection fraction in trial VEG108844.

basis.text: The application received Standard Review priority designation.

summary.text: VOTRIENT received regular (full) approval under a standard review for the treatment of patients with advanced renal cell carcinoma, based on a statistically significant improvement in progression-free survival in a placebo-controlled Phase 3 trial (VEG105192).

citations.quote: The reviewers recommend regular approval of pazopanib at the proposed dosing schedule for the treatment of patients with advanced RCC. This is based on the findings of a robust improvement in progression-free survival (PFS) with pazopanib in a placebo-controlled study and of an acceptable safety profile for pazopanib as demonstrated in the submitted clinical studies of the product.

requirement.text: 1549-1: Examine the safety of dose modification of pazopanib and patient rechallenge following hepatotoxicity, including at least 1,500 treated patients (trials VEG108844, VEG110727, VEG110665).

citations.quote: 1549-1. Examine the safety of dose modification of pazopanib and patient rechallenge with pazopanib following hepatotoxicity. This examination should include at least 1,500 treated patients and may be derived from ongoing or completed trials, including VEG108844, VEG110727, and VEG110665.

requirement.text: 1549-2: Examine the cardiotoxicity, clinical cardiac events and changes in ejection fraction in ongoing trial VEG108844.

citations.quote: 1549-2. Examine the cardiotoxicity, clinical cardiac events and changes in ejection fraction in your ongoing trial VEG108844.

requirement.text: 1549-3: Submit the final report of the hepatic impairment trial, protocol NCI 8063.

citations.quote: 1549-3. Submit the final report of the hepatic impairment trial, protocol NCI 8063.

requirement.text: 1549-4: Submit the final report of the dedicated QTc prolongation trial, VEG111485.

citations.quote: 1549-4. Submit the final report of the dedicated QTc prolongation trial, VEG111485.

requirement.text: 1549-5: Conduct a drug-drug interaction trial using clinical doses of oral pazopanib and a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor (e.g., ketoconazole).

citations.quote: 1549-5. To adequately determine the influence of strong CYP3A4 inhibitors on the exposure of pazopanib following oral clinical pazopanib doses, conduct a drug-drug interaction trial in patients using clinical doses of oral pazopanib and a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor (e.g., ketoconazole).

requirement.text: 1549-6: Submit the final analysis of overall survival in ongoing trial VEG105192.

citations.quote: 1549-6. Submit the final analysis of overall survival in your ongoing trial VEG105192.

requirement.text: 1549-7: Pending outcome of trials VEG108844, 110727, or NCI 8063, develop a 100 mg dosage form (tablet) to allow proper dose reductions when liver enzyme elevations occur.

citations.quote: 1549-7. Pending the outcome of trials VEG 108844, 110727, or NCI 8063, you may need to develop a 100 mg dosage form (tablet) to allow for proper dose reductions of Votrient™ (Pazopanib) when liver enzyme elevations occur.

requirement.text: 1549-8: Submit the final report with complete datasets for ongoing trial VEG108844 (pazopanib versus sunitinib in locally advanced and/or metastatic RCC).

citations.quote: 1549-8. Submit the final report with complete datasets for ongoing trial VEG108844 titled: "A Study of Pazopanib versus Sunitinib in the Treatment of Subjects with Locally Advanced and/or Metastatic Renal Cell Carcinoma".
